title: State Management Architecture
description: Design scalable state management with Context API, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, React Query, and server state patterns.
longDescription: Learn state management patterns: client state with Context, Redux Toolkit, Zustand; server state with React Query; form state with React Hook Form; and architectural patterns for separating concerns.
whatYouLearn: Context API for prop drilling avoidance
Redux Toolkit for complex client state
React Query for server state caching and synchronization
React Hook Form for performant form handling
State architecture patterns and separation of concerns
